data.exact_reserve_text: During the year there was a positive net run-off contribution of GBP 36,411,000 (2013 GBP 45,805,000), of which the main contributors were third party liability, GBP 9,020,000 and marine, aviation and transport GBP 3,590,000 (2013 marine, aviation and transport GBP 7,492,000 and other damage to property GBP 10,507,000). There was a positive development on reinsurance acceptances of GBP 26,795,000 (2013 GBP 25,109,000).
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a net favourable prior-year development (net run-off contribution) of GBP 36.411m in 2014, driven primarily by releases in third party liability and marine/aviation & transport business and by positive development on reinsurance acceptances. No gross prior-year movement figure was published; the quoted amount is net of reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure provided in the notes is explicitly described as a 'net run-off contribution' and therefore is net of reinsurance; no gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement figure was presented. Opening reserves are taken from the balance sheet prior-year comparative (gross claims outstanding). 'Marine, aviation and transport' was mapped to 'Marine' for LOB mapping where needed. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior-year development were identified in the text.
